name: robo-architect-desktop
description: Robo Architect Lite — desktop app (Electron shell + host Architect API + Docker stack on Ontological DB).
author: uEngine

scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:figma && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:figma && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:figma && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:figma && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.win.js
